packageRules.description: Keep both php-base digests current: PHP_BASE_IMAGE (:8.4) and PHP_BASE_DEV_IMAGE (:8.4-dev) in the Dockerfile, in one PR so they move together. This is the CVE patch path: the base is rebuilt weekly, and Renovate opens the bump here.
Moving to another PHP line (8.4 -> 8.5) is a decision, not a routine bump: digests only.
MariaDB stays on the 11.4 LTS line: a new line is a deliberate upgrade, with a backup first. Its digest stays current.
